visible.message:
An Enum stored in st.session_state compares False to Color.RED, while comparing their .value values returns True. I expect the Enum equality comparison to work. Streamlit 1.31.0, Python 3.11.6, macOS Sonoma 14.3, Chrome. Here is the complete reported example:

import streamlit as st
from enum import Enum, auto

class Color(Enum):
    RED = auto()
    BLACK = auto()
    YELLOW = auto()
    
if 'color' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.color = Color.RED
    

st.code("st.session_state.color == Color.RED")
st.write(st.session_state.color == Color.RED)

st.code("st.session_state.color.value == Color.RED.value")
st.write(st.session_state.color.value == Color.RED.value)
